knacks.name: Read the Crowd
knacks.trigger: When you work a busy market for gossip, rumor or who-owes-whom.
knacks.clean_effect: Ask the DM two questions about the people around you; the answers are true.
knacks.cost_effect: Ask one question; someone in the crowd notices you asking.

knacks.name: Ask the Shrine
knacks.trigger: When you make an offering at a shrine and ask its god one question.
knacks.clean_effect: The god answers truly and plainly.
knacks.cost_effect: The god answers truly, but you owe it a favor.

knacks.name: Rooftop Runner
knacks.trigger: When you move fast across tarps, awnings, cables and rooftops.
knacks.clean_effect: You get where you meant to go, unseen, with a moment to spare.
knacks.cost_effect: You get there, but drop something, tear something, or are spotted.

knacks.name: Quick Fingers
knacks.trigger: When you lift, plant or palm something, or pick a lock.
knacks.clean_effect: It's done, and nobody knows it was you.
knacks.cost_effect: It's done, but someone will notice it missing soon.

knacks.name: Back-Alley Patch
knacks.trigger: When you patch flesh or chrome with whatever the stalls have.
knacks.cost_effect: Clear 1 Harm, but it used up something you'll miss.

knacks.name: Prayer-Net Tap
knacks.trigger: When you splice into a god's prayer network to listen or reroute.
knacks.clean_effect: Learn who has been praying for what, or redirect one prayer.
knacks.cost_effect: It works, but take a tick of Fade or owe the god a favor.

knacks.name: Stand Your Ground
knacks.trigger: When you hold a place or a person against someone trying to take it.
knacks.clean_effect: They can't get past you without paying for it.
knacks.cost_effect: They don't get past, but you take the hit meant for someone else.

knacks.name: Say Their Name
knacks.trigger: When you speak the name of someone or something the city has forgotten.
knacks.clean_effect: The listener remembers, and the memory sticks.
knacks.cost_effect: The listener remembers for now, but it will slip unless someone else says it too.

knacks.name: Ear for Tongues
knacks.trigger: When you try to follow speech in a language you don't speak.
knacks.clean_effect: You catch the gist and the tone.
knacks.cost_effect: You catch the tone, or the gist at a cost.
